train.stayForNextHelp: With auto-join on, when a train on this data center that auto-join would take starts within 20 minutes, skip the way home and the after-ride action and let auto-join take it.
train.after.stay.name: Stay where you are

changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: Every update, newest first.
changelog.r1100.1: Added one-off S-Hunts: S-rank relays from HuntAlerts now appear in the list with an S-Hunt button that travels to the mark, waits at a safe distance for another player to pull, joins the fight and ends once the kill is credited, contributed by Asha-00
changelog.r1010.1: Added a Buy Me a Coffee button under Patreon on the About page
changelog.r1000.1: Rides hunt trains announced through HuntAlerts, with a Ride button on every train, auto-join per expansion and snooze
changelog.r1000.2: Travels to the train's world, data center and instance through Lifestream, and carries a ride across the data center relog
changelog.r1000.3: Follows the conductor's map flags from Shout, Yell and Say, picking the conductor from the announcement, the first flag, or by hand
changelog.r1000.4: Waits for the pull and lands a hit on each A rank for credit, never starting a pull itself
changelog.r1000.5: Joins the train's party, returns home after the ride, and records every train in History
changelog.r1000.6: Opens each train's details with Flag on map, Party Finder, Nav and Relay, and catches up with trains that already left their start
changelog.r1000.7: A Humanizer with random reaction delays, so the character is never the first to move
about.support.title: Made with love and care
about.support.body: This plugin is a one-person project, built in my free time because I love this game and its community. Keeping it updated takes a lot of those hours. If it has helped you, supporting me on Patreon or buying me a coffee means I can keep giving it that time. Thank you for being here.
about.support.coffeeHint: Open Buy Me a Coffee · right-click to copy
about.linkHint: Click to open · right-click to copy
about.discordBody: Get help, report bugs, share ideas and hear about updates first.
about.githubBody: Browse the source code and every release.
about.reminder.title: A little reminder
about.facts.title: Did you know?
about.quotes.title: Words to live by
about.jokes.title: Just for fun
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: The language of this plugin's windows. Zone, mark, and world names always follow the game client.
settings.cat.feedSub: Which trains to auto-join, and how to hear about them.
settings.cat.rideSub: Following the conductor, fighting the marks, and what happens after.
settings.general.openOnLoginHelp: Pop the main window automatically the next time you log in.
settings.general.autoPauseHelp: Pause the ride while you are inside a duty, trial, raid, or any other instanced content, then resume it once you are back outside. Your ride and session stats are kept.
settings.general.pauseTypingHelp: While a text box of the game has focus, like the chat line, the ride starts no new move until you close it. A move already under way carries on, and the latest flag is taken once you are done.
plugin.commandHelp: Toggle the Auto Hunt Train window. /aht config | stats | deps | log | changelog | about | pause (pause or resume the ride) | conductor <First Last>[@World] or conductor clear (whose flags to follow) | snooze [minutes] or snooze off (suspend auto-join) | inject <World> <DT|EW|SHB|Centurio> [aetheryte] [i<n>] [+minutes] [conductor:First Last] [body:text] (inject a test train) | inject srank <World> <creature name> <x> <y> [aetheryte] [i<n>] [body:text] (inject a test S-rank relay) | target (dump the current target's BaseId) | goto <territory> <x> <y> <z>, goto <world> [aetheryte] [i<n>] or goto home (travel helpers, goto stop cancels).
session.autoResumeHelp: If the ride hits an unexpected error and stops, restart it automatically (up to 3 times in 5 minutes) instead of ending it. The restarted ride takes the conductor's latest flag and never follows one it already finished. Turn it off if you would rather have errors end the ride.
safety.cat.upkeepSub: Repair and food during a ride. They run only in a lull while the ride waits for a flag, never on the way to one or during a fight.
safety.cat.partyInvitesSub: On a train, party members share the credit on a mark. Join the parties the crowd offers, find one with a shout, and leave it once the ride is over.
safety.cat.gmAlertSub: Detects nearby Game Masters and reacts: stop the ride, ping you, or take more drastic action.
safety.upkeep.quietHelp: Repair and food wait until the ride has been waiting this long without a new flag, so they never hold you back when the conductor moves on. A flag that arrives meanwhile stops them. The upkeep before a data center transfer does not wait.
safety.repair.autoRepairHelp: When the lowest equipped item drops to or below the threshold, the plugin repairs in a lull between flags and before a data center transfer. During a ride only Dark Matter from your bag is used; a trip to a repair NPC waits for the upkeep before a transfer. At 0% the gear stops working, so keep some margin.
safety.repair.autoRepairOff: Auto-repair is off. Enable it to configure repair.
safety.repair.thresholdHelp: Trips when the worst equipped slot reaches this condition percentage. 20% leaves comfortable margin before the 0% breakdown.
safety.repair.sourceHelp: How the repair is performed. Self-repair uses Dark Matter from your bag (no travel). NPC repair travels to your Grand Company mender.
safety.repair.selfThenNpc.name: Self, then NPC
safety.repair.selfThenNpc.detail: Use Dark Matter from your bag first; fall back to the Grand Company mender when you run out.
safety.repair.selfOnly.name: Self only
safety.repair.selfOnly.detail: Repair with Dark Matter from your bag. No travel.
safety.repair.npcOnly.name: NPC only
safety.repair.npcOnly.detail: Travel to your Grand Company mender (or a custom NPC) and repair there.
safety.repair.customNpcHelp: Optional. Travel to any repair NPC instead of the Grand Company mender. Target the NPC in-game, then click "Set from target". Clear to fall back to the GC mender.
safety.repair.npcNote: NPC repair uses your custom repair NPC if set, otherwise your Grand Company mender, teleporting there when needed. A custom NPC removes the Grand Company requirement.
safety.repair.npcNone: None: the Grand Company mender is used.
safety.repair.noTargetChat: No target. Target a repair NPC first, then click again.
safety.consumables.autoConsumeHelp: Use food and medicine in a lull between flags to keep their buffs up; Well Fed alone is a free +3% EXP. Items are consumed only out of combat, and refreshed before the buff runs out.
safety.consumables.autoConsumeOff: Auto-consume is off. Enable it to pick items.
safety.consumables.refreshUnderHelp: Re-consume once the buff has fewer than this many minutes left. 0 only re-applies after it fully wears off. A meal lasts 30 minutes.
safety.consumables.addItemHelp: Pick from the food and medicine in your bag. HQ is used automatically when you have it.
safety.consumables.activeItemsHelp: Each is kept active in order; the next available one is consumed if the first runs out.
safety.consumables.noneInBag: No food or medicine in your bag. Stock some, then add it here.
safety.consumables.noItemsAdded: No items added, so nothing will be consumed.
safety.party.acceptHelp: While a ride is running, accept party invites on their own. Nothing is accepted while you are already in a party, while the ride is paused, or while a data center transfer is pending, and invites outside a ride are left to you.
safety.party.lfgHelp: Once per ride, after arriving at the train's start and while not in a party, send one line in Shout asking for a party.
safety.party.lfgTextHelp: The line sent in Shout. Keep it short; an empty text sends nothing.
safety.party.leave: Leave the party after the ride
safety.party.leaveHelp: When a ride ends on its own, leave the party before the way home. A party you were in before the ride started is kept. Before a data center transfer the party is always left, since the game refuses the transfer otherwise.
safety.party.partyFinderHelp: Once per ride, after arriving at the train's start and while not in a party, put up a public listing in the Party Finder's The Hunt category so other riders can join you. Your other recruitment settings are kept from your last listing. The listing is ended when the ride ends or is stopped, and the game ends it once the party is full. While it is up, players can join only through the listing, not by invite.
safety.party.partyFinderCommentHelp: The comment shown on the listing. The box stops at the length the game accepts; an empty comment lists with none.
safety.party.partyFinderFailedChat: The Party Finder listing could not be put up; the ride goes on. The log has the details.
safety.party.partyFinderStillUpChat: Your Party Finder listing is still up; end it from the Party Finder.
safety.gm.stopRunHelp: End the ride at once when a GM appears nearby. It is recorded as stopped, and nothing runs after it: no way home and no after-ride action. Strongly recommended; the other alerts are little use if the ride keeps going.
safety.gm.toastHelp: Pop a Dalamud toast: "GM <name> is nearby!"
safety.gm.chatHelp: Print a red chat warning into your local log.
safety.gm.soundHelp: Plays a series of system beeps through your speakers. Loud enough to grab your attention if you're tabbed away.
safety.gm.beepCountHelp: How many beeps to play in the burst.
safety.gm.commandsHelp: Chat commands to run when a GM is spotted. Useful for things like /logout, /sh stay calm, or a macro.
safety.gm.killHelp: Hard-terminate the game process via /xlkill. The last-resort option; no goodbyes, no cutscene, no logout. You'll get a disconnect.
ride.card.none: No conductor picked yet. Recent flag posters in Shout, Yell and Say on this world show up in the list.
ride.settings.shoutHelp: Follow flags the conductor posts in Shout, the channel most trains run on.
ride.settings.yellHelp: Follow flags the conductor posts in Yell, which some trains use to spare the Shout channel.
ride.settings.sayHelp: Follow flags the conductor posts in Say. Handy when you stand next to the conductor, or when you test the ride with your own flags.
ride.settings.lateJoinHelp: When a ride starts, the conductor's last flag is still followed if it is at most this old. An older flag is skipped and the ride waits for the next one.
ride.settings.idleHelp: How long the ride waits for the conductor's first flag. When none arrives in this time, the ride ends on its own.
ride.settings.quietEnd: End after the conductor goes quiet
ride.settings.quietEndHelp: Once the ride has reached a flag, it ends on its own when no new flag from the conductor arrives for this long and no fight is going on.
ride.settings.endOnPhrase: End when the conductor says so
ride.settings.endOnPhraseHelp: End the ride when the conductor says in Shout, Yell, Say or party chat that the train is over, with words such as "thanks for coming" or "that's all". A fight in progress is finished first. Only English phrases are recognized for now.
ride.settings.waitForPullHelp: Hold at the flag until someone else has pulled the mark, then join the fight. Off attacks the mark as soon as it is in sight, which makes you the one who pulls it.
ride.settings.pullWaitHelp: How long to wait at a flag for the mark to show up and be pulled. When the time runs out, the ride gives the mark up and waits for the next flag.
ride.settings.endWhenAllCredited: End when every mark is credited
ride.settings.endWhenAllCreditedHelp: End the ride on its own once as many marks are credited as the expansion has A ranks: 17 in A Realm Reborn, 12 in every later expansion.
ride.settings.tagWithRangedHelp: Attack marks with one weak attack instead of the full rotation, so a mark that melts in seconds lives long enough for the whole train to land a hit. One landed hit is all the credit asks. Tanks and melee jobs use their ranged attack from about 20 yalms; ranged jobs, casters and healers use their basic single-target attack. BossMod still dodges, and anything else that attacks you is fought with the full rotation. When the attack cannot go off for 15 seconds with the mark in range, that mark is fought with the full rotation too. Jobs without such an attack, such as Monk, and characters that have not learned it yet fight marks as usual.
ride.settings.flagTeleportHelp: How the ride gets into the zone of a flag posted in another zone.
ride.settings.teleportMyselfDetail: The ride teleports itself to the attuned aetheryte best placed for the flag.
ride.settings.waitForTeleportDetail: The ride waits until you are in the flag's zone, whether you teleport yourself, take a party member's teleport or another plugin such as Hunt Train Assistant takes you there, then travels on from where you land without teleporting again within the zone.
ride.settings.teleportWaitHelp: How long the ride waits for that teleport before it teleports itself. At 0 s it never does, and gives the flag up after 20 minutes without one. A newer flag ends the wait at once, and the wait does not count against the time the ride allows itself to reach the flag.
ride.settings.acceptTeleportsHelp: During a ride, accept a party member's teleport offer when it leads into the zone of the flag being followed, or into a hunt zone while no flag is known. An offer that comes during a fight or while the ride waits at its flag is accepted once that is over, if that is within a minute. The ride then travels on from where the party landed. Offers from outside the party, to anywhere else or outside a ride are left for you to answer.
humanizer.tabSub: Short random pauses before the ride acts, the way a player reacts.
humanizer.enabledHelp: Wait a random moment before each action below, drawn anew each time between the shortest and the longest value. A shortest value above the longest is used as a fixed wait. Off acts at once.
humanizer.moveOff: Moving off to a new flag
humanizer.moveOffHelp: After the conductor posts a new flag, before any teleport or move toward it. A newer flag during the wait starts over with its own wait.
humanizer.teleportHelp: Before each teleport the ride casts, on the way to a flag and while catching up with a train.
humanizer.engageHelp: Once someone has pulled the mark, before joining the fight. Skipped when the mark is already under half health.
humanizer.inviteHelp: Before accepting a party invite during a ride.
humanizer.shoutHelp: After arriving at the train's start, before the looking-for-group shout goes out.
humanizer.teleportOfferHelp: Before accepting a party member's teleport offer during a ride.
humanizer.partyFinder: Putting up a Party Finder listing
humanizer.partyFinderHelp: In a lull after arriving at the train's start, before the Party Finder is opened to put up the listing.
humanizer.combatMovementEnableHelp: BossMod steps out of an AoE the moment it is telegraphed and stops right at its edge, so everyone on a mark who runs this plugin dodges on the same frame to the same spot. When on, each mark rolls a dodge delay, a movement delay and a preference for extra room from the ranges below. The combat preset itself is never changed.
humanizer.combatMovementOff: Combat movement variation is off. BossMod dodges the way the combat preset is set up.
humanizer.combatMovementNoModule: The combat preset '{0}' has no Automatic movement (AI) module, so these settings do nothing there. Add that module to the preset in BossMod, or delete the preset there so the next ride puts the bundled one back.
humanizer.dodgeDelayHelp: How long BossMod waits before stepping out of a telegraphed AoE. One value is rolled per mark from this range. Longer delays mean getting hit more often and more knockouts, and casters may see more casts cancelled.
humanizer.moveDelayHelp: How long BossMod waits before any other repositioning, such as getting back into range of the mark. It only applies when starting to move from standing still. Most players can leave this at None.
humanizer.dangerRoomHelp: Asks BossMod to prefer spots further inside safe ground rather than the very edge of an AoE. This is a soft preference, not a guaranteed distance: it depends on BossMod's map resolution, and the lower levels may change nothing at all.
feed.rideHint: Travel to the start of this train and follow it
feed.rideCatchUpHint: The train has moved on from its start; the ride catches up with it
feed.sHuntHint: Travel to this S rank, wait for another player to pull, then join the fight
feed.verdict.outOfRegion: This train runs in another region
feed.verdict.inDuty: Leave the duty or its queue first
feed.verdict.lifestreamBusy: Lifestream is busy with something else
feed.verdict.sRankCrossDataCenter: S-Hunts can visit another world on this data center, but not another data center
feed.verdict.feedWorldUnknown: The announced world is not one this client knows
feed.conductor.picked: Conductor: {0}, picked from the first flag
feed.conductor.pendingIn: The first player to post a flag in {0} becomes the conductor
feed.conductor.pending: The first player to post a flag becomes the conductor
feed.settings.autoJoinHelp: Trains of this expansion are joined without a click when they pass the rules below. Every train can always be ridden with its Ride button.
feed.settings.dataCentersHelp: Auto-join and the train notifications take only trains on the ticked data centers, and the My data centers view lists only them. With none ticked, only your home data center counts.
feed.allHidden: Trains were announced, but none on your allowed data centers. Pick My region or Everywhere to see the others.
feed.allHiddenRegion: Trains were announced, but none in your region. Pick Everywhere to see them all.
feed.settings.noHomeRegion: Log in to list the data centers of your region.
feed.settings.crossDataCenterHelp: Let auto-join take a train that needs a data center transfer; a Ride button click can always cross. The transfer logs the character out and back in, and Lifestream must have data center travel enabled.
feed.settings.minimumLead: Lead time for another data center
feed.settings.minimumLeadHelp: Auto-join skips a train on another data center whose start is closer than this, because a data center transfer takes minutes plus a queue. Trains on your own data center are joined as soon as they are announced, and a train that already started is still joined for three minutes after its start.
feed.settings.snoozeLengthHelp: How long /aht snooze suspends auto-join and the train notifications. /aht snooze off lifts it early.
notify.settings.openWindowHelp: When a train on your allowed data centers that you could ride is announced, open this window on the Train page. While you type in a text box it waits for you to finish, for up to 30 seconds. Nothing happens during a ride, a duty or a cutscene, or while auto-join is snoozed.
notify.settings.flashTaskbar: Flash the taskbar in the background
notify.settings.flashTaskbarHelp: When a train on your allowed data centers that you could ride is announced while the game is in the background, flash its taskbar button until you switch back to it.
notify.settings.chatAlertHelp: When a train the Upcoming trains list shows is announced, post one line in chat with a link to its details. It follows the list's view, and stays quiet during a ride, a duty or a cutscene, or while auto-join is snoozed.
notify.settings.chatSoundHelp: Play one of the game's chat sounds with the chat line.
notify.settings.chatSoundEffectHelp: Which of the game's sixteen chat sounds plays, the same as <se.1> to <se.16> in a chat message. Changing it plays it once.
notify.settings.testHelp: Opens the Train page and flashes the taskbar a few times, for whichever of the two is on.
notify.settings.huntAlertsNote: HuntAlerts only detects the trains; the alerts above come from this plugin. Turn HuntAlerts' own chat alert and banner off in its settings, or each train is announced twice.
details.title: {0} train on {1}
details.noBody: The announcement carried no text beyond its details.
details.catchUpNote: Riding now catches up with the train along its usual route
details.flagHint: Open the map with a flag on the train's start
details.flagHint.sRank: Open the map with a flag on the S rank's reported location
details.partyFinderHint: Open the Party Finder on the Hunts category
details.navHint: Point an on-screen arrow at the train's start while you are in {0} on {1}. Right-click the arrow to clear it.
details.navHint.sRank: Point an on-screen arrow at the S rank's reported location while you are in {0} on {1}. Right-click the arrow to clear it.
details.navOnHint: The arrow points at this train's start. Click to clear it.
details.navSet: The navigation arrow shows once you are in {0} on {1}.
details.navSetHere: The navigation arrow points at the train's start.
details.navTooltip:
Train start {0}
Right-click to clear the arrow
details.relayHint: Post a one-line summary of this train to {0}
details.relayHint.sRank: Post a one-line summary of this S rank to {0}
details.settings.relayChannelHelp: Where the Relay button on a train's details posts its one-line summary. The arrow next to the button picks another channel for a single post.
details.settings.relayFlagHelp: When the train's start has map coordinates, place your map flag there and post <flag> in their place, so the channel gets a spot to click.
